title: open source tps players to u
features: tps players to u so u can hit them i guess
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
local pulling = false
local conn = nil

-- keybind is "C" btw
game:GetService("UserInputService").InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
	if gp then return end
	if input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.C then return end
	pulling = not pulling
	if pulling then
		conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			local myHRP = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not myHRP then return end
			for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if p == lp then continue end
				local hrp = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				-- 200 studs so it dosent frickin get people in lobby
				if hrp and (hrp.Position - myHRP.Position).Magnitude <= 200 then
					hrp.CFrame = myHRP.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -2)
				end
			end
		end)
	else
		-- stops tping 😱
		if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn = nil end
	end
end)
